keywords: qteasy 如何防止未来函数
title: Lookahead isolation: per-step data windows
summary: The engine injects only the window visible at the current step. get_data sees that window; window_length is lookback length; use_latest_data_cycle controls whether the current bar is included.
narrative:
qteasy prevents lookahead by isolating history per step. Before realize() runs, the engine injects the data window that belongs to the current bar. Inside realize(), get_data(dtype_id) returns only that window—not the full series through a later date.

window_length is how many past periods that window spans. use_latest_data_cycle decides whether the window may include the current bar (True) or only already-closed bars (False). That switch is a modeling choice the framework exposes; this card does not invent profit impact numbers for it.

Declaring which DataTypes and windows a custom strategy needs, and what realize() must return, is the custom-strategy realize card. Why people pick qteasy over a hand-written pandas loop is the advantages card—this card is the mechanism.
